action_summary: Spends no oracle questions at all: the failing assertion already carries the value the site owes, pytest hands it over as a live object in one run of the whole test file, and each candidate in the closure is then judged by evaluating it inside the recorded frames (~10 microseconds) instead of running the suite (0.5 s). Thirty fresh commits, none used by any earlier round, across click, jinja and attrs; the whole sweep costs 74.9 s including worktrees and verification.

blocker_lease_key: 2026-10-09-resource-bounded-bytes-v1::GENERAL_REUSABLE_PROBLEM_SOLVING_CAPABILITY_FRONTIER::The selection of one expression out of the closure of the language. The address is solved for free (the site is handed over in both arms, an upper bound no system could beat). The vocabulary is computable (dir() of the live types, 4 microseconds, nothing stored). The grammar is the language's. What remains is rank: the right expression sits at 2887 in the one row the base arm could reach, and at a rank the wide arm measures for the others, while each oracle question that tests one candidate costs 0.5 s. Selecting is therefore the only thing left, and a memory of one demonstrated action supplies one selected element and no ordering over the 10^5 alternatives the language admits.
causal_blocker: A failing test supplies a PREDICATE and a WITNESS, not an identifier. Measured over the fourteen in-class rows: 6 reach for another object's attribute, 3 for a method on such an attribute, 4 are guards (is None / or / ternary), 2 are names the site already had, 1 is an f-string over a frame name. Only that last one is a value the frame can compute in the ordinary sense. Selection cost therefore falls only to the degree the demand is selective, and a demand is selective only when it names an object -- which is a grammar of predicates over an enumerable reference space, not a larger closure and not a better prompt.
expected_parent_change: The claim that the demanded value converts selection into evaluation is confirmed arithmetically (0.5 s vs ~10 microseconds, 10,000x, 2.5 s per commit end to end) and refuted as a capability claim: precision is 1/1 but recall is 1/15 in class, and the first verified patch was a constant. What moves next is the admission rule and the predicate reader, with acceptance numbers declared before the build.
expected_parent_frontier_change: The frontier moves from 'the demand is a value' to 'the demand is a predicate over an enumerable reference space'. Two numbers are now on the record as falsifiers for the next round: the human's fix must become admissible in at least 10 of 14 rows (now 1 of 14), and verified generalising repairs must go from 1 to at least 8 of 30 (now 1). A round that adds vocabulary or grammar without a predicate reader is spending effort on the half that was already measured cheap.

It is a fact about this reader and this table on these rows: the demand is often nested in a helper, where the reader falls back to prose. next_step: Build the predicate reader and the reference space, in this order: (1) parse the failing assert from the crash entry's OWN path and derive a predicate -- falsy, truthy, is None, is not None, equality to a live value, not in, string containment, exception type -- because today the reader falls back to prose whenever the assert is nested in a helper, and prose is a witness, not a demand; (2) admit name.attribute over dir() of every value in the frame, already in the instrument; (3) require the predicate to flip between the failing occurrence and the passing ones. Acceptance: >=10/14 admissible, >=8/30 verified, and no verified patch may name nothing in the frame.
real_outcome: 30 fresh commits: 15 are structural edits (not a single-expression replacement), 1 has a site that never ran in the failing test, 13 have a known demand that no candidate produced, and 1 is verified with the whole file green (47 tests) and the patch IS the human's own fix. The first receipt of this round verified a DIFFERENT patch: a literal string that reproduced the demanded value on the one name the test used, green in fact and wrong in general -- the synthesis-verification asymmetry measured inside this instrument rather than borrowed from the literature. The one-line admission rule that refuses any candidate naming nothing in the frame turned that wrong green patch into the correct rule on the same row, with the demand and the space unchanged. Against this, the completeness witness is unambiguous and negative: the human's own replacement is admissible by the table in 1 of 14 in-class rows.

obs_solution.efficiency_mechanism: Ordering and exact fit replace breadth: 409 flips decided 15 commits, and no candidate refinement was scored, ranked or thresholded.
obs_solution.generality_mechanism: The rewrite is generic Python AST plus a counter; the oracle is the project's own pytest; the address is a site and a firing, so it carries to any executable artifact.
obs_solution.losing_routes_reason: Message channel: 1 of 15 at the line, 0 at the expression. Whole-predicate flips: cannot express a guard that is right once and wrong once. Scoring: unnecessary once fit is exact. Stored state: costlier than re-measuring in ~50 microseconds.

recursive_obs.stop_condition: STOP when the population's shape is censused before measurement, when both arms run on the same fresh corpus with the same declared cap and budget, when every miss is named by a computed taxonomy rather than counted, when an unresolvable row is reported as unresolved within the cap and never as impossible, and when parameters_stored is 0 in both arms.
recursive_obs.why_selected_route_is_fastest_sufficient: Because the question 'is the content a knowledge problem' can only be answered by handing the address over for free and measuring what the artifact's own words can say; every other route answers it by assuming an answer.
recursive_obs.why_this_is_not_another_organ: It adds no knowledge, no vocabulary and no model: one AST rewrite of the module, one counter, one log of what was already in scope, and the project's own pytest as the verdict.
